intent: Compact read-only chip that shows a variable value bound into an inspector input, with an optional detach control.

tokens.note: Only the Selected state and the label type use tokens; every other color is hardcoded, not tokenized: OnSelected bg + border #dbd8ff, Hover bg #e6e6e6, muted (SoftDeleted / ValueNotRendered / disabled) bg #f5f5f5, Default bg white, non-selected border #e6e6e6, text rgba(0,0,0,0.9) (rgba(0,0,0,0.3) when disabled), detach glyph rgba(0,0,0,0.5) -> 0.9 on hover. Shape is hardcoded too: radius 5px, px 4px, gap 4px, label max-width 80px. By design this atom renders fixed light colors regardless of dark mode.

a11y.role: none - the chip is a presentational <div>; the optional detach affordance is a native <button>.
a11y.note: The detach <button> renders no aria-label, so the control is unlabeled; supply one host-side. The value label truncates with an ellipsis at max-width 80px.
